content: Rohan Deshmukh contacted insurance agent Anjali Desai to discuss his auto insurance policy (AU-4521), which had expired on 15/09/2026. After learning about the standard renewal cost of ₹12,500 and inquiring about discounts, Rohan qualified for a 5% safe driver discount, lowering the total to ₹11,875. Rohan decided to proceed with the renewal, and Anjali agreed to send the renewal invoice via email.

action_items: Anjali will send the renewal invoice via email
Rohan will complete the payment upon receiving the invoice
